title: T2Font and Rinkaku: glyph representation packages for Unity uGUI text
description:
T2Font is a Unity package for uGUI text that splits a font asset into a typography table and a pluggable glyph representation (SDF included), with a pure C# TrueType reader and baker, a .t2font importer, a viewer and a conformance suite.

Rinkaku is a glyph representation for T2Font that keeps TrueType outlines as quadratic Bézier segments and draws them by exact signed distance through a per-texel index of the nearest segments, so SDF-style edge effects (dilation, softness, outlines) work while edges stay sharp at any size. It is designed for CJK text in games.
